supersedes_note: Canonical, SINGLE control-identifier mapping for the pre-Stage-B build-provenance controls. No contradictory duplicate identifiers exist. F-DR-01 and F-DR-02 are the two mandatory pre-Stage-B controls; each maps to exactly one acceptance test family and its lifecycle gate + blocking effect.

controls.name: Clean exact-SHA build context + .dockerignore hardening
mechanisms: tools/hermes_clean_build_context_v1.py (git-archive exact-SHA export + deterministic manifest + security scan)
controls.blocking_effect: Stage B FAILS (image build MUST NOT proceed) if the clean exact-SHA context cannot be produced, if the manifest diverges from tracked git content, or if a prohibited-path / secret finding appears in the effective (post-.dockerignore) build context.
controls.legacy_scope: The clean-context requirement governs FUTURE candidate builds; the running legacy image c5fc2a62f424 is not retroactively rebuilt.

controls.name: Source-SHA + build-UTC OCI provenance labels
mechanisms: Dockerfile runtime-stage ARG SOURCE_SHA + ARG BUILD_UTC + LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision + org.opencontainers.image.created
tools/hermes_image_label_verify_v1.py (full-40-hex revision + tz-aware UTC created; candidate-readiness fail-closed)
controls.lifecycle_gate: Stage B (build) — label emission; verified before Stage C readiness audit
controls.blocking_effect: Stage B FAILS if EITHER label is absent, empty or malformed, or if the revision label does not match the clean build-context source SHA. Labels are MANDATORY, not optional recommendations.
controls.legacy_scope: The legacy image c5fc2a62f424 carries no provenance labels; it is NOT retroactively invalid. The requirement applies to FUTURE candidate images only. The legacy image does NOT set the contract for new candidate images.

safety_gate_acceptance.purpose: Socket CONNECTED is never transport health; connected alone can neither authorise nor deny reconnect as-if-proven.

Strict mode: unavailable July-16 heartbeat -> evidence-incomplete -> reconnect unauthorised. Inference-permitted mode: JUSTIFIED_INFERENCE preserved and never relabelled DIRECTLY_OBSERVED; shadow proposal-only.
